Create a high-resolution landscape character turnaround reference sheet for an artist modelling an enemy for Institute, a premium gothic dungeon fantasy game. Regular finished raster image, beautifully painted realistic materials with stylized readable forms, not a screenshot or a 3D file. Neutral light warm-grey studio background and soft even lighting that reveals every surface. Four full-body views in one evenly spaced row: FRONT, LEFT SIDE, BACK, THREE-QUARTER. Consistent identical character, equipment, proportions and scale in all four views. Orthographic front side and back; mild perspective only in three-quarter. Relaxed A-pose with limbs separated enough to model, feet on a common baseline, ample margins, nothing cropped. Small clean title and small view labels only. Weathered stone, old iron, bone, dark desaturated cloth, restrained teal magic belong to the existing dungeon art direction. Rich tactile surfaces, clear construction, restrained glow that does not hide shapes, no fog, scenery, UI, gore, action pose, extra characters, or decorative frame. Subject: SKELETON, a lean ancient skeletal foot soldier, 1.65 metres tall, exposed anatomically readable ivory rib cage, separate vertebrae and paired forearm bones, complete bony hands and feet. Corroded iron half-helmet exposes skull and jaw with small teal eye lights. Broken asymmetric breastplate covers only one upper chest side, worn rounded pauldrons, leather diagonal baldric and belt, small iron bracers and shin plates, narrow ragged dark teal cloth down the back. A chipped straight sword held down in the anatomical RIGHT hand, clearly separated from legs; no shield. Maintain armor and sword on the correct anatomical sides in every view. Title: SKELETON.
